title: A morphism lifts to a morphism of injective resolutions
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $h:X\to Y$ a morphism of $\mathcal A$, and $s_X:X\to P^\bullet$, $s_Y:Y\to Q^\bullet$ injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions] with $P^q=Q^q=0$ for $q<0$ (so $0\to X\xrightarrow{s_X}P^0\to P^1\to\cdots$ and $0\to Y\xrightarrow{s_Y}Q^0\to Q^1\to\cdots$ are exact). Then there is a morphism of complexes $\varphi:P^\bullet\to Q^\bullet$ with $\varphi^0\circ s_X=s_Y\circ h$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 013P (lemma-morphisms-lift), part (2), applied to alpha = s_X : X[0] -> P (a quasi-isomorphism injective in every degree) and gamma = s_Y o h : X[0] -> Q (Q bounded below of injectives)
